candidates.name: user_org_creation
evidence: Listed in DEFAULT_FLAGS with a fixed boolean default: user_org_creation: false
validate() only allows names present in DEFAULT_FLAGS.keys, so this is an intentionally supported flag
enabled?(feature_flag_name) returns persisted value if present, otherwise falls back to DEFAULT_FLAGS.fetch(feature_flag_name.to_sym), so the flag has a defined runtime behavior

proposed_patch.diff:
--- a/app/models/runtime/feature_flag.rb
+++ b/app/models/runtime/feature_flag.rb
@@ -1,31 +1,31 @@
 module VCAP::CloudController
   class FeatureFlag < Sequel::Model
@@
     DEFAULT_FLAGS = {
       user_org_creation: false,
       private_domain_creation: true
     }.freeze
@@
     def self.enabled?(feature_flag_name)
       feature_flag = FeatureFlag.find(name: feature_flag_name)
       return feature_flag.enabled if feature_flag
       DEFAULT_FLAGS.fetch(feature_flag_name.to_sym)
 
     rescue KeyError
       raise UndefinedFeatureFlagError.new "invalid key: #{feature_flag_name}"
     end
@@
   end
 end
